attributes.gen_ai.tool.call.arguments: "{\"content\":\"#!/usr/bin/env python3\\n\\\"\\\"\\\"Generate a deterministic synthetic event dataset and save it as CSV.\\n\\nEach row is one event with a group, a timestamp, a category and a numeric\\nvalue. Group sizes are deliberately uneven and one group starts partway\\nthrough the range, so downstream backtest code has to handle real-world\\nirregularities.\\n\\nUses only the standard library. Output is fully deterministic for a given\\nseed, start date and day count.\\n\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\nimport argparse\\nimport csv\\nimport random\\nfrom datetime import datetime, timedelta\\nfrom pathlib import Path\\n\\n# Per-group behaviour: average events per day, base value, daily trend, and\\n# how many days into the range pass before the group starts emitting events.\\nGROUPS = {\\n    \\\"alpha\\\": {\\\"events_per_day\\\": 4.0, \\\"base\\\": 10.0, \\\"trend\\\": 0.05, \\\"start_offset_days\\\": 0},\\n    \\\"beta\\\": {\\\"events_per_day\\\": 2.5, \\\"base\\\": 25.0, \\\"trend\\\": -0.02, \\\"start_offset_days\\\": 0},\\n    \\\"gamma\\\": {\\\"events_per_day\\\": 6.0, \\\"base\\\": 5.0, \\\"trend\\\": 0.10, \\\"start_offset_days\\\": 3},\\n}\\n\\nEVENT_TYPES = (\\\"click\\\", \\\"view\\\", \\\"purchase\\\")\\n\\nCSV_FIELDS = [\\\"event_id\\\", \\\"group_id\\\", \\\"timestamp\\\", \\\"event_type\\\", \\\"value\\\"]\\n\\n\\ndef generate(seed: int, start: datetime, days: int) -> list[dict]:\\n    rng = random.Random(seed)\\n    rows = []\\n    for group, spec in GROUPS.items():\\n        n = round(spec[\\\"events_per_day\\\"] * (days - spec[\\\"start_offset_days\\\"]))\\n        for _ in range(n):\\n            day = rng.randrange(spec[\\\"start_offset_days\\\"], days)\\n            second_of_day = rng.randrange(24 * 3600)\\n            timestamp = start + timedelta(days=day, seconds=second_of_day)\\n            value = spec[\\\"base\\\"] + spec[\\\"trend\\\"] * day + rng.gauss(0, 1.0)\\n            rows.append({\\n                \\\"group_id\\\": group,\\n                \\\"timestamp\\\": timestamp.isoformat(sep=\\\" \\\"),\\n                \\\"event_type\\\": rng.choice(EVENT_TYPES),\\n                \\\"value\\\": f\\\"{value:.4f}\\\",\\n            })\\n    # ISO timestamps sort lexicographically, so plain string sort is correct.\\n    rows.sort(key=lambda r: (r[\\\"timestamp\\\"], r[\\\"group_id\\\"]))\\n    for i, row in enumerate(rows):\\n        row[\\\"event_id\\\"] = i\\n    return rows\\n\\n\\ndef main() -> None:\\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)\\n    parser.add_argument(\\\"--seed\\\", type=int, default=42)\\n    parser.add_argument(\\\"--start\\\", default=\\\"2024-01-01\\\", help=\\\"Start date, YYYY-MM-DD\\\")\\n    parser.add_argument(\\\"--days\\\", type=int, default=30, help=\\\"Length of the range in days\\\")\\n    parser.add_argument(\\\"--output\\\", default=\\\"data/events.csv\\\", help=\\\"Output CSV path\\\")\\n    args = parser.parse_args()\\n\\n    start = datetime.strptime(args.start, \\\"%Y-%m-%d\\\")\\n    if args.days < 1:\\n        parser.error(\\\"--days must be at least 1\\\")\\n\\n    rows = generate(args.seed, start, args.days)\\n\\n    output = Path(args.output)\\n    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\\n    with output.open(\\\"w\\\", newline=\\\"\\\") as f:\\n        writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=CSV_FIELDS)\\n        writer.writeheader()\\n        writer.writerows(rows)\\n\\n    print(f\\\"Wrote {len(rows)} events to {output}\\\")\\n    by_group: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}\\n    for row in rows:\\n        by_group.setdefault(row[\\\"group_id\\\"], []).append(row)\\n    for group, group_rows in by_group.items():\\n        print(f\\\"  {group}: {len(group_rows)} events, \\\"\\n              f\\\"{group_rows[0]['timestamp']} -> {group_rows[-1]['timestamp']}\\\")\\n\\n\\nif __name__ == \\\"__main__\\\":\\n    main()\\n\",\"path\":\"generate_events.py\"}"
